sourceText: “Bless me, Poole, what brings you here?” he cried; and then taking a second look at him, “What ails you?” he added; “is the doctor ill?”

attempts.label: primary
attempts.visibleOutput:
TRANSLATION: “a, jan Pulu o! seme li kama e sina tawa ni?” ona li toki wawa. ona li lukin sin e jan Pulu, li toki e ni: “ike seme li lon sina? jan Jekil pi sona sijelo li pilin ike anu seme?”
NOTES: NONE
